The exact pinned runtime is absent. adapters/fastenhancer/requirements.lock pins CPython 3.10 macOS arm64 with onnxruntime==1.20.1 (wheel SHA-256 e50ba5ff7fed4f7d9253a6baf801ca2883cc08491f9d32d78a80da57256a5439) and the adapter records data/envs/dtln-onnx as its evaluator environment; neither is present here. The source repository is MIT, but the release page records no separate pretrained-model terms and neither the linked asset ledger nor the rights register has a Base entry; the rights register records only fastenhancer_m, fastenhancer_s, fastenhancer_t and fastenhancer_t_16k. Evaluation, acquisition, redistribution, customer deployment and public playback for Base are unestablished.

All eight release gates remain blocked and no result may qualify the candidate.

The documented Base geometry is the 16 kHz DNS path (512-point FFT, 256-sample hop, 256-sample buffering delay, five caches including three recurrent caches), not the installed v0 160-sample frame. No v0 frame adapter, resampler or native engine is implemented or claimed.
